punchline: Hope Jahren moved her lab to Hawaii on one condition: a funded job for Bill Hagopian, or none for her.
thirty_sec: Hope Jahren built three labs in three states, and in each one she hired Bill Hagopian, her lab partner and best friend. At Johns Hopkins, she told Time, her lab was lost when the money ran out during her pregnancy. So when Hawaii made an offer, she set the terms: if there was no job for Bill, there was no job for her. The offer came with funding for him, and she took it.
